events.title: 맨체스터 유나이티드 drop two priceless points in the Premier League title race as they can only manage a 1–1 draw with City in the Manchester derby at Old Trafford. It is the first time since the 1991–92 season that they have failed to beat City in either derby games.
A record of eight black players are capped in the England side's 3–1 home defeated by Australia at Upton Park.

One of the most decisive games of the season sees 아스널 cancel out 맨체스터 유나이티드 in the double race with a 2–0 win at Old Trafford . After the game, 데이비드 베컴 suffers a gash to his face which is reportedly the result of Sir 알렉스 퍼거슨 throwing a basket full of boots across the changing room after his side's defeat.
맨체스터 유나이티드 drop points once again when relegation threatened Bolton hold them to a 1–1 draw at the Reebok Stadium .

The month-end leaders for February are 아스널, who now lead 맨체스터 유나이티드 by five points. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드, 첼시 and 에버턴 complete the top five. There will now be a place in the UEFA Cup for the Premier League's sixth place team if 맨체스터 유나이티드 or 리버풀 (who contest this weekend's League Cup final) finish in the top five. Currently in sixth place are 찰턴 애슬레틱, while 리버풀 are still only seventh in a division which they had looked set to win a few months ago. 포츠머스 have a two-point lead over 레스터 시티 at the top of Division One. Reading, 노팅엄 포리스트 and 셰필드 유나이티드 remain in the playoff zone, but an improving 울버햄프턴 원더러스 side have edged 노리치 시티 out of the top six. 로더럼 유나이티드 are in contention for promotion after an impressive season so far.
